LEGAL-001.note: new customer: enabled, not accepted, can accept; anonymous status → 401

LEGAL-002.note: unaccepted customer: enquiry, save and enquiry list → 403; nothing written

LEGAL-003.note: unknown field, accepted:false and a bad scope → 400; anonymous accept → 401

LEGAL-004.note: accept → 200; repeat → 200; status accepted; enquiry → 201 (acceptance rows 1)

LEGAL-005.note: active dealer without dealer terms: console API → 403; after accepting → 200

LEGAL-006.note: a DRAFT dealer can finish onboarding paths without terms; other console routes → 403

LEGAL-007.note: unaccepted customer opening /enquiries → streamed redirect (200 + NEXT_REDIRECT/meta refresh) to /login?returnTo=%2Fenquiries; /login renders the terms gate
